lines.text: Any chance I could watch another episode? No?
I like plenty of other genres, not just romance.
I received a signal to move! M-may I move?

I can't believe the Commander and I share the same interests...
Feels like I'm in a dream!

C-Commander... I just learned of a lovely cafe from watching TV,
would you like to go there for a coffee with me?

I can't thank you enough for how much confidence you've given me. 
You're the best!

It's not weird if I just stand here, is it? 
Should I be doing something?

It looks like you're pretty busy. I can wait for you here.
After all, you've waited before for me to finish watching a TV show!
I'm nearly done with this series! I'll sleep in a second!
D-did you call me? How can I help you?
Why is the signal so bad in the Outpost?
I'm picking up a signal... Could it be fate?
C-can I really be this strong...?
I feel safer! Thank you...
I-I will work harder!
I-is that a gift...?
I like it very much... Th-thank you!
M-my heart is racing!
I-I can't get the commander out of my head... What should I do?
We can really have a picture perfect romance, just like in the movies!
Commander! I've sent you a love signal!
M-may I go with you?
You called?
We will move according to the signal received.
E-enemy ahead! Proceed with caution!
C'mon Signal, you can do this!
Battle start!
E-enemy ahead!
Faster...!
Reload... Please...!
I-I'll reload!
It's the signal!
D-danger! Please! Requesting backup!
So shoot... just like this?
T-target down!
I made it!
Did I take down the target...?
Ahh!
Agh!
Hrrrrnngh!
I-I'm sorry I couldn't be much help...
V-victory!
